name: voyage-ai
description: Voyage AI - Interactive AI Travel Exploration Tool and Itinerary Engine

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
